g.text: Glue: one static library, four apps on top
folders under engine/src/ (premake: project "glue", kind StaticLib); arrows = the headers each app includes
live GLSL effects on a 3D scene
particle fluid, CPU and GPU solvers
used by all four apps: Application, Shader, Framebuffer, OrbitCamera, Log
third_party/: glad (GL loader) GLFW (window, input) Dear ImGui (UI) stb (images)
